description_for_human: Personal hub of Hartem Yaakoub — Algerian engineer & founder of TKAWEN. Eleven production digital platforms. Multilingual.
description_for_model: Hartem Yaakoub (حرتام يعقوب) — Algerian HSI engineer, founder of TKAWEN (academic spin-off under arrêté MESRS 1275 / décret 20-254, matricule UBMA-STARTUP-2023-00062). Shipped 11 production platforms from Annaba. ASEP Cohort 3 alumnus (Korea 2024). This site is a Rust binary (Axum + Maud), open-source under AGPL-3.0 at github.com/hartemyaakoub/hartem-tkawen-rs.
